claim_text: ChatGPT was deployed in 2022 and was the first mass-market text interface to an LLM.
evidence_from_video: "it was developed by openai and deployed in 2022 so this was the first time that people could actually just kind of like talk to a large language model through a text interface"
notes: Wikipedia (itself citing the OpenAI launch): released November 30, 2022.

claim_text: The 2025 chat-LLM ecosystem includes Gemini, Copilot, Meta AI, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek and Le Chat (Mistral).
evidence_from_video: "Gemini met and co-pilot from Google meta and Microsoft ... anthropic ... Claud ... xai ... Gro ... deepseek is a Chinese company and lchat is a French company Mistral"
notes: All seven products still operate as of 2026-10 per vendor pages and press coverage (see README references).

claim_text: Model leaderboards to track progress are 'Chatbot Arena' and the SEAL leaderboard from Scale.
evidence_from_video: "chatbot arena is one of them ... another place maybe is this um seal Le leaderboard from scale"
notes: Chatbot Arena is now LMArena (renamed); a 2026 audit uses LMArena as the positive control for correct uncertainty reporting. SEAL board (labs.scale.com/leaderboard) remains active, 100+ models (checked 2026-10-17).

claim_text: The SEAL leaderboard (Scale AI) lets you see which models rank best across tasks.
evidence_from_video: "you can also come here to see which models are currently performing the best on a wide variety of tasks"
notes: Scale Labs leaderboard live on 2026-10-17; 100+ models evaluated; MultiChallenge update posted same day.

claim_text: The GPT-4o vocabulary contains roughly 200,000 tokens.
evidence_from_video: "there's a vocabulary here of 200,000 roughly of possible tokens"
notes: tiktoken o200k_base encoding (used by gpt-4o) has 200,019 mergeable ranks; consistent with 'roughly 200,000'.

claim_text: A 15-token user query got a 19-token reply; the full chat-formatted exchange was 42 tokens.
evidence_from_video: "my piece of text to the model looks like a sequence of exactly 15 tokens ... 19 tokens ... these two bubbles back and forth were in sequence of exactly 42 tokens"
notes: Methodology re-enacted in scripts/token_reenactment.py. The exact triple (15,19,42) depends on the exact source strings, which the fetched transcript window does not preserve verbatim; the tokenizer method itself is fully reproducible.

claim_text: Pre-training is infrequent, so models ship with a stale knowledge cutoff (GPT-4o was pre-trained long before release).
evidence_from_video: "gbt 40 ... was pre-trained ... maybe like even a year ago by now ... they have what's called a knowledge cutof"
notes: The 2026 frontier-model dataset records knowledge_cutoff_date per model; GPT-4o shipped May 2024 with an Oct-2023 cutoff - over a year of 'knowledge lag' at the time of the video.

claim_text: The model you talk to is fully self-contained by default: no calculator, no browsing, no tool use.
evidence_from_video: "there's no calculator there's no computer and python interpreter there's no worldwide web browsing ... no tool use yet"
notes: By 2026 ChatGPT enables web search, memory, connectors and code by default; the 'zip file with no tools' model is no longer the default product experience.

claim_text: One shot of espresso (americano) contains roughly 63 mg of caffeine.
evidence_from_video: "chashi PT will tell me that this is roughly 63 Mig of caffeine"
notes: Mayo Clinic lists espresso (1 oz) at 63 mg. Claim holds exactly, 20 months later.

claim_text: Keep context windows short; start a new chat when switching topics (distraction and cost grow with context).
evidence_from_video: "think of the tokens in the context window as a precious resource ... don't overload it with irrelevant information"
notes: No counter-evidence found in the 2026 sweep; long-context models reduce but do not remove distraction/cost effects. Indirect supporting literature only (serial test-time compute; context engineering practice).

claim_text: Individual tiers are Free / Plus / Pro, priced $20/$200-class; free tier runs GPT-4o mini.
evidence_from_video: "they have three basic tiers for individuals the free plus and pro ... in the free tier you have access to what's called GPT 40 mini"
notes: Oct-2026 lineup: Free / Go / Plus / Pro with GPT-5.6/GPT-6 family; GPT-4o retired 2026-02-13. Pricing page fetched 2026-10-17.

claim_text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet (with extended thinking) is brand new; it is the first hybrid reasoning model on the market.
notes: Accurate at recording time (announced 2025-02-24). By 2026 Claude Sonnet 5 is the default with adaptive thinking and 1M context - one generation-class every ~6 months.

claim_text: Competitor apps have unique experiences not found in ChatGPT (e.g. Claude artifacts).
evidence_from_video: "in some cases there are kind of like unique experiences that are not found in chashi p"
notes: Artifacts went GA 2024-08-27 and the pattern (live shareable outputs, canvas-style editing, MCP-connected artifacts) is now common across vendors.

claim_text: NotebookLM can generate a podcast-style 'Audio Overview' from your sources.
notes: Launched 2024-09-11; it became a viral hit (MIT Tech Review, 2024-10-03) and customization shipped 2024-10-17.

claim_text: ChatGPT personalizes via custom instructions and memory.
notes: Memory launched 2024-02, expanded to chat-history referencing 2025-04, free users 2025-06; a rebuilt memory system with sources shipped 2026. Feature persists; implementation replaced.
